REQ-023.design_rationale: Section 2.1 specifies Ledger.reconcile_orphaned_work_items() in scripts/ledger.py to identify active work items with unclaimed tokens (claimed = 0) where WORK_PREPARED exists but no corresponding HANDOFF_ACCEPTED event occurred, transitioning them to TERMINATED. It hooks into inject-rules.py (before creating new work items) and attention-check.py (before evaluating Stop). Section 2.1 also designs Primary Agent interception of manage_subagents(Action='kill' | 'kill_all') in scripts/enforce-delegation.py to transition target subagents to TERMINATED, and defaults unrecognized termination reasons on fully_idle=True subagent Stop to WORK_TERMINATED_OK / WORK_TERMINATED_ERROR.
REQ-023.tasks_rationale: Task 1 implements Ledger.reconcile_orphaned_work_items() in scripts/ledger.py, wires it into scripts/inject-rules.py and scripts/attention-check.py, adds manage_subagents(Action='kill' | 'kill_all') termination in scripts/enforce-delegation.py, and adds fully_idle=True fallback in scripts/attention-check.py. Task 5 adds regression tests in tests/test_ledger_performance.py and executes system_audit.py --repair-db to clean the 4 stale ACTIVE database rows.
REQ-023.evidence_rationale: verification.md Section 2 cites tests in tests/test_ledger_performance.py (test_reconcile_orphaned_work_items_and_walkthrough_gate, test_manage_subagents_kill_terminates_work_items, test_subagent_stop_unrecognized_reason_fully_idle) passing under rtk pytest (191 passed). REQ-024.design_rationale: Section 2.2 defines normalize_command_signature() in both scripts/enforce-delegation.py and dsh-attention-guard-plugin/src/circuit-breaker.ts. It strips rtk, sudo, and leading sleep delays, mapping log/file polling (tail, head, wc, and read-only Python file slicing) to POLL_FILE:<path> and process inspection (pgrep, ps) to POLL_PROC:<target>. Section 2.2 integrates signature comparison in check_subagent_doom_loop() and specifies actionable denial guidance instructing subagents not to busy-wait in shell loops.
REQ-024.tasks_rationale: Task 2 implements normalize_command_signature() and actionable remediation messaging in scripts/enforce-delegation.py (check_subagent_doom_loop) and dsh-attention-guard-plugin/src/circuit-breaker.ts (checkDoomLoop). Task 5 adds unit and E2E regression tests covering 3-strike file and process polling denials.
REQ-024.evidence_rationale: verification.md Section 2 cites test_doom_loop_polling_signature_normalization in tests/test_ledger_performance.py passing under rtk pytest, and tests/circuit-breaker.spec.ts passing under vitest (10 tests, 70 total in dsh-attention-guard-plugin), verifying normalized command signatures and circuit-breaker denials on the 3rd consecutive poll.

REQ-025.design_rationale: Section 2.3 defines extension-scoped TEST_TAMPER_PATTERNS across .py, .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs, and .go in scripts/enforce-delegation.py and dsh-attention-guard-plugin/src/guards.ts. It designs line-level parsing that strips comments (#..., //...) and quotes string literals before checking tamper markers, eliminating false positives on test fixtures testing tamper detection (e.g. tests/guards.spec.ts) while strictly blocking executable skip decorators and assertions.
REQ-025.tasks_rationale: Task 3 updates check_test_tampering() in scripts/enforce-delegation.py and checkTestTampering() in dsh-attention-guard-plugin/src/guards.ts to scope patterns by extension and ignore string literals/comments. Task 5 adds regression tests in tests/test_ledger_performance.py and dsh-attention-guard-plugin/tests/.
REQ-025.evidence_rationale: verification.md Section 2 cites test_check_test_tampering_language_scoping_and_quoted_strings in tests/test_ledger_performance.py passing under rtk pytest, and tests/guards.spec.ts (24 tests) passing under vitest, verifying language-scoped tamper marker checking and allowing quoted string literals in test files.

REQ-026.design_rationale: Section 2.4 specifies pre-split regex normalization collapsing backslash-newlines into single spaces prior to subcommand splitting and tokenization in check_destructive_command() (scripts/enforce-delegation.py and dsh-attention-guard-plugin/src/guards.ts), and ignores whitespace-only target tokens when evaluating rm targets so multiline rm -rf commands targeting valid paths are not misidentified as targeting newline characters.
REQ-026.tasks_rationale: Task 4 normalizes backslash-newline line continuations in check_destructive_command() across both Python and TypeScript implementations. Task 5 verifies with multiline test fixtures ensuring valid multiline commands pass while catastrophic targets remain blocked.
REQ-026.evidence_rationale: verification.md Section 2 cites test_check_destructive_command_multiline_backslash_rm in tests/test_ledger_performance.py passing under rtk pytest, and tests/guards.spec.ts passing under vitest, verifying multiline backslash-newline normalization allows valid paths while blocking catastrophic rm targets.
